root.label: Cramps Goo Goo Muck gains new audience through Wednesday

events.label: Cramps Goo Goo Muck gains new audience through Wednesday

slots.name: feature date
slots.sentence: A cult act in its time, the band found a whole new audience in 2022 when its version of “Goo Goo Muck” by Ronnie Cook and the Gaylads was featured in a goth dance sequence in the Netflix series “Wednesday.”
